question: Who was the flag bearer for India for the closing ceremony of the Asian Games 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Rampal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rani Rampal:-**

 
 
• She is an Indian field hockey player.
 
• **She is the captain of the Indian women's hockey team and plays as a forward. **
 
• She has played 212 international matches and scored 134 goals.
 
• Rampal has led the Indian women's hockey team to many successes, including a silver medal at the 2018 Asian Games and a fourth-place finish at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
 
• **She was the flag bearer for India for the closing ceremony of the Asian Games 2018.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanjeev Rajput:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian rifle shooter who competes in the 50m Rifle 3 Positions category. **
 
• He was introduced to sport shooting at 20 when he was serving in the Indian Navy.
 
• He first tasted international success at the 2004 South Asian Games, winning three golds and a silver medal.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian track and field athlete, who is the reigning Olympic champion and World champion in Men's javelin throw. **
 
• He is the first Asian athlete to win an Olympic gold medal and the first Asian to win gold in his event at the World Championship.
 
 
 
• **Deepak Kumar:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian sport shooter and a Junior Commissioned officer (JCO) in the Indian Air Force. **
 
• He has been competing in shooting since 2005 and has won several medals at national and international competitions.
